name: pdf-library
title: PDF Library
description: Browse and search PDFs in a local directory with metadata preview
author: nate-app

commands.name: search-pdfs
commands.title: Search PDFs
commands.description: Search through PDFs in your library directory

preferences.name: libraryPath
preferences.title: Library Path
preferences.description: Path to the directory containing your PDFs (e.g. ~/Documents/textbooks)

commands.name: organize-loose-files
commands.title: Organize Loose Files
commands.description: Auto-sort book-type files at the library root into the appropriate subfolder using AI

preferences.name: libraryPaths
preferences.title: Library Paths
preferences.description: Comma-separated roots to scan for loose files. Each root is scanned independently; loose files at that root are classified against its subfolder tree.

preferences.name: extensions
preferences.title: Extensions to Organize
preferences.description: Comma-separated file extensions treated as book-type files

preferences.name: miscFolderName
preferences.title: Misc Fallback Folder
preferences.description: When the AI can't confidently classify a file, offer to move it to this folder within the same scan root. Leave blank to disable.

commands.name: test-ai-connection
commands.title: Test AI Connection
commands.description: Diagnostic: runs a few small AI.ask calls and reports latency / errors

commands.name: organize-loose-math
commands.title: Organize Loose Math Files
commands.description: Auto-sort loose book-type files in the Mathematics folder into the right math subfolder using AI

preferences.name: libraryPaths
preferences.title: Library Paths
preferences.description: Comma-separated math root(s) to scan. Each root is scanned independently against its own subfolder tree.

preferences.name: extensions
preferences.title: Extensions to Organize
preferences.description: Comma-separated file extensions treated as book-type files

preferences.name: miscFolderName
preferences.title: Misc Fallback Folder
preferences.description: When the AI can't confidently classify a file, offer to move it to this folder within the same scan root. Leave blank to disable.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
